title: Minimal Hyperbolic Area of Teichmuller Curves in Genus Two
summary: We determine the minimum hyperbolic area of Teichmuller curves arising from holomorphic quadratic differentials on closed Riemann surfaces of genus two. The minimum is 3π/5, and it is attained precisely by quadratic differentials q=ω^2 for which the translation surface (X,ω) lies in the GL_2^+(R)-orbit of the double-pentagon translation surface. Equivalently, the extremal projective Veech group is the triangle group Δ(2,5,\infty).
